headline: Whirlpool reduces Black Friday promotions in Latin America amid margin pressures
summary: Appliance manufacturer Whirlpool is cutting back Black Friday discounts in Latin America, modifying pricing strategies for Consul and Brastemp brands to protect margins.
why: Whirlpool Corporation manufactures global home appliances and holds strong market positions across Latin America.

impacts.name: Whirlpool Corporation
impacts.why: Restricting seasonal discounts protects operating margins but may lower retail volume.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
